name: arc
description: Development tools for the VS Code extension.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css
scripts.test: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:smoke
scripts.test:iterate: npm run typecheck && npm --prefix extension run test:node
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:root && npm run test:panel-mockup && npm --prefix extension test && npm --prefix cli run test:unit
scripts.test:smoke: vitest run test/hooks-smoke.test.js && npm --prefix cli run test:smoke
